mapper.update: UPDATE product_image SET is_primary = FALSE WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND deleted = FALSE AND is_primary = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT f.file_key AS fileKey, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.create_time AS createTime FROM t_file f WHERE f.folder_type = #{folderType} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_image i WHERE i.file_key = f.file_key AND i.deleted = FALSE) ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
